caption: Jesus quotes Psalm 22 and Paul says Christ was made sin for others. But neither verse says he was forsaken because of others’ sins—that link is inferred.

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: Forsaken because he bore others’ sins? Jesus quotes Psalm 22’s cry on the cross. Paul says the sinless Christ was made sin for others.
slides.body: Jesus quotes Psalm 22’s cry on the cross. Paul says the sinless Christ was made sin for others.
slides.heading: Forsaken because he bore others’ sins?

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: The theology fits together Many Christians understand the cry as the cost of Jesus bearing human sin. Both ideas matter to the cross.
